source: BRO groundwater monitoring wells (GMW), retrieved 12 November 2026 through publiek.broservices.nl: sources/dsfl/bro-gmw-amersfoort-1km.xml (the characteristics search in a circle of 1 km) and sources/dsfl/bro-gmw-amersfoort-1km.geojson (the same wells as points, derived from it), recorded in sources/sources.lock.json. The center is the centroid of Stadhuisplein 1, 3811LM Amersfoort in the PDOK Locatieserver: RD 154792.05 463172.16, WGS84 5.38416472 52.15671963.
note: Origin: a groundwater question for an initial check against public BRO services. The reference holds the 57 wells of the search, with the broId as identificatie and standardizedLocation (EPSG:4258) as a point. The 12 required wells have removed nee and a delivered RD location within 500 m of the centroid. The removed well GMW000000133351 is optional; the 44 outside 500 m are not allowed. The standardized and delivered locations differ by at most 0.07 m; the 5 m tolerance accommodates rounding and simple conversions. Two required wells lie 0.8 m apart and require two places, assigned one-to-one. The closest non-required well is 138 m from a required well. Open for the working group: whether a removed well or a well under review counts, and whether another register of wells counts too.
